checks: The barycentric second moments of the uniform triangle give Σ=(sum of vertex outer products)/12, with diagonal 1/2 and off-diagonal −1/4. The displayed three normals are covariance-unit and sum to zero. Their averaged quadratic is the stated form and has volume mean one.

The three halfspaces are the barycentric apex caps at threshold 1/3. Similarity gives ordinary fraction 4/9 and Grünbaum gives the full lower bound at the centroid. Away from the centroid some barycentric coordinate is greater than 1/3, yielding a strictly smaller through-mark apex cap.

The equal-area cone sectors give density dv/3 on each edge. The edge quadratic is 12v²−12v+4. Direct integration gives total two and captured integral 64/81 on the two last-two-thirds intervals. The normalization is therefore (4/9+t·64/81)/(1+2t), strictly below 4/9.

At the centroid the constant denominator is the optimizer by first-order stationarity and strict convexity, so E=V and q_H=1/(2V). The source-plus-covariance density is (1+Q)ν_V, with the exact fraction 100/243.
